findings.title: Urgent persuasive language
findings.impact: The content uses urgency to pressure a quick response without verification.
findings.recommendation: Review the message for social engineering cues and flag it before forwarding.
findings.limitations: Urgency alone is not proof of malicious intent; context matters.

findings.title: Embedded URL requires review
findings.impact: A URL embedded in the message may merit URL-level warning or blocking.
findings.recommendation: Review the linked destination before sending or clicking the message.
findings.limitations: The content analysis did not include live website checks.

checks.detail: Urgency and persuasive wording were detected in the message body.
URL review was deferred because the message analysis is context-limited.

precautions: Do not forward or click suspicious links without verification.
limitations: This is not a guarantee of safety, but it is a trigger for manual review.
